newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline softer, market very slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline softer, market very slow.

text.p: NWE gasoline was weaker and noticeably quieter on Friday, traders said.
A Eurograde barge was sold at $218 fob AR, down $2 or so from Thursday, but no other trade was heard.
"Its less than zero," said one barge trader.
Supplies of gasoline look good in Europe as local refineries pump out mogas in the drive for middle distillates production.
The trans-atlantic arb to the United States appears closed out of the Rotterdam area which means U.S interest for European gasoline cannot be translanted into business.
